headline: Anime and velocity styles, motion tracking, colour wheels and 18 new effects.
notes: One-tap styles: anime AMV, velocity, phonk, aesthetic, cinematic, gaming, product, meme, sports, listicle and talking-head cleanup.
"Sync my clips to the track" now keeps your clips and your order and only moves the cuts onto the beat.
Motion tracking: draw a box, follow anything through a shot, pin a blur, a sticker or a title to it.
18 effects including real motion blur, chromatic split that pulses on the beat, zoom blur, glow, speed lines, impact frames, halftone, cel shading, VHS wobble and CRT.
Three-way colour wheels — lift, gamma and gain — running as a GPU filter, not a per-pixel loop.
Real speed ramps: the speed changes through a shot and the audio follows it.
Stickers and callouts: 42 emoji plus arrows, circles, speech bubbles, progress bars and countdowns.
The AI recognises named styles and asks a question when the answer would change the edit.
